    <p>MSc thesis examining whether DeepSeek R1's stated reasoning actually reflects the factors driving its answers.</p>
    <details>
      <summary>Details</summary>
      <p>We found that the model changed its behaviour in response to a hint embedded in the prompt, without referencing that hint anywhere in its chain-of-thought. This implies that the COT is not a faithful representation of the underlying reasoning but would be better considered a post-hoc explaination. Published in the ACL Anthology as part of IJCNLP-AACL 2025, CHOMPS workshop.</p>
      <a href="https://aclanthology.org/2025.chomps-main.2/" target="_blank">Read the paper →</a>

<script>
(function() {
  const grid = document.getElementById('project-grid');
  const cards = Array.from(grid.querySelectorAll('.project-card'));
  const filterBar = document.getElementById('project-filters');

  const groups = {
    type: { label: 'Type', values: new Set(), active: new Set() },
    status: { label: 'Status', values: new Set(), active: new Set() },
    tags: { label: 'Tags', values: new Set(), active: new Set() }
  };

  cards.forEach(card => {
    groups.type.values.add(card.dataset.type);
    groups.status.values.add(card.dataset.status);
    (card.dataset.tags || '').split(',').map(t => t.trim()).filter(Boolean)
      .forEach(tag => groups.tags.values.add(tag));
  });

  function buildGroup(key) {
    const g = groups[key];
    const wrap = document.createElement('div');
    wrap.className = 'filter-group';

    const label = document.createElement('span');
    label.className = 'filter-group-label';
    label.textContent = g.label + ':';
    wrap.appendChild(label);

    Array.from(g.values).sort().forEach(value => {
      const btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.type = 'button';
      btn.className = 'filter-pill';
      btn.textContent = value;
      btn.dataset.group = key;
      btn.dataset.value = value;
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        btn.classList.toggle('active');
        if (g.active.has(value)) g.active.delete(value);
        else g.active.add(value);
        applyFilters();
      });
      wrap.appendChild(btn);
    });

    return wrap;
  }

  filterBar.appendChild(buildGroup('type'));
  filterBar.appendChild(buildGroup('status'));
  filterBar.appendChild(buildGroup('tags'));

  function applyFilters() {
    cards.forEach(card => {
      const cardTags = (card.dataset.tags || '').split(',').map(t => t.trim());
      const typeOk = groups.type.active.size === 0 || groups.type.active.has(card.dataset.type);
      const statusOk = groups.status.active.size === 0 || groups.status.active.has(card.dataset.status);
      const tagsOk = groups.tags.active.size === 0 ||
        cardTags.some(t => groups.tags.active.has(t));

      card.style.display = (typeOk && statusOk && tagsOk) ? '' : 'none';
    });
  }
})();
</script>
